Four Seasons Hotel - Danang-Hoi An - Top of its Game
Feb 2018 • Friends
We have been to several Four Seasons hotels including a recent trip to Costa Rica. They are all amazing properties. This one tops them all. Our sweet has two buildings, a separate living room which must be 900 ft.² as well as a master bedroom that has two lounging areas. Room also comes with a private butler, includes unlimited laundry service as well as a complementary snack bar. Our room also has an extremely large beachfront pool that is heated. The breakfasts are indescribable. I cannot imagine a better property in this wonderful area of the world. Apparently not all rooms come with a private butler and laundry service. If you require such services the room is amazing. NOTE:All photos of our bedroom room, our living room (separate building) and our private beachfront heated pool!!!!

Perfect get Away
Apr 2017 • Friends
The Four Seasons brand lived up to its name in Vietnam. The service and quality of the resort were first class and staff could not do enough for you. The choice and quality at breakfast was great and service levels were superior to anything I have experienced. There are 2 great pools and there is easy access to the beach. The rooms were great and very well equipped. I would totally recommend the Four Seasons as a world class experience. Make sure you have the full name and address of the hotel as taxi drivers don't always know it by the new name of the location. Paul

Relaxing place, good food
Apr 2014 • Friends
Nice open air place with good food at decent prices.
The owner (nice guy, viet-american so speaks good english) created a more western influenced menu with dishes that you cannot find at the nearby seafood places.
Good mix of seafood, pork and beef.
Big place with a nice breeze from the nearby beach.
Relaxing atmosphere, went there a few times and enjoyed it.
